definition: Five independent trial values per condition. Native first click separate from repeat clicks; repeat = median of four clicks within each trial, then median of five trials. Native renderer Paint, handler, two-rAF proxy and saved status are distinct. Screen values are DOM/rAF/opacity/inert proxies, not confirmed physical display. Screen before is the previous production-path run of the identical frozen baseline; same browser/fixture/runner, different sampling epoch. Production native A-then-B; temporary synthetic AB/BA. Descriptive max(1ms,10%) guard is not significance. All negative results retained, no cross-condition average. Supplemental production synthetic operations have no production before values; never mix temporary ratios into production rates.
